subject: Partner portal credentialing + SKU bundling for Nebula Analytics listing
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nebulaconsulting.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nebula listing readiness: next steps for portal creds and SKU bundle

Hi Dylan —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. Nebula is ready to start the marketplace intake but we need two things from Redwood to move the co-sell uplift:

1) Portal service account / partner console credentialing for our integrations team (GCP and Azure).
2) SKU bundling guidance so we can present a clean offer to pubs and avoid duplicate metering.

I've attached a first pass of a suggested SKU mapping (Nebula_SKU_bundle_v2.xlsx) and our internal partner intake checklist. Can you confirm the right contact for partner-portal access and an estimate for how long Redwood needs to approve a listing parity request?

Would love to set a 30-min sync with you + your GTM partner alias this week. Morning PT works best for us.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Nebula Consulting
attachment: Nebula_SKU_bundle_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
attachment: partner-portal-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nebulaconsulting.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nebula listing readiness: next steps for portal creds and SKU bundle

Maria —

Appreciate the materials. Quick answers inline:

- Partner portal / service account: Laura (cc'd) owns our partner ops handoff and will open the portal invite for Nebula. Expect an invite + minimal onboarding checklist within 48 hours.
- SKU bundling: Ben (cc'd) and I reviewed the sheet. We have two notes: (a) avoid overlapping token-level SKUs between our hosted API and Dedicated bundles, and (b) add an explicit line for dedicated seat-hour metering if Nebula plans to resell reserved capacity.

Proposed next step: 30-min technical + GTM sync Thursday 10:00 PT. Laura, Ben — can you join? Vivek, I want you in for the co-sell entitlements conversation.

I'll also share the internal approval turnaround we typically see for parity requests (usually 5–7 business days once portal artifacts are complete).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai

Hi Maria —

I'll open the partner portal access today. Action items for Nebula on my side:
- Confirm the partner admin email we should invite (we'll send a service account onboarding doc).
- Complete the intake form (link below) so our compliance team can pre-check the listing artifacts.

I attached the Redwood partner portal checklist — it outlines the documents we require for Azure/GCP co-sell validation. Once we receive the items, internal routing to Marketplace Ops takes ~3 business days.

Proposed Thursday 10:00 PT works for me. Invites are out.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference

related link: https://drive.google.com/partner-intake-form

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, maria.lopez@nebulaconsulting.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nebula listing readiness: next steps for portal creds and SKU bundle

Following our sync this morning: quick summary and asks (so we have a single thread):

- SKU mapping: Maria will update the worksheet with separate lines for (1) hosted API per-token SKU, (2) embedding-only SKU, and (3) Dedicated seat-hour SKU. We'll validate if any metering shim is required for cross-cloud resale.
- Co-sell entitlements: Vivek to share recommended partner tag and co-sell call-to-action; expect a draft by EOD Friday.
- Compliance artifacts: Laura to submit initial packet to Marketplace Ops once Nebula completes the intake form.

Ben will be the Redwood point of contact for pricing proofs; Maria, please add estimated customer price bands in the sheet so we can validate competitive placement.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Ecosystem Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nebulaconsulting.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nebula listing readiness: next steps for portal creds and SKU bundle

Maria —

Sharing the initial co-sell tag + CTA language we recommend for the marketplace listing (copy paste friendly):

"Redwood & Nebula: Real-time analytics for customer-facing ML — deploy with predictable latency and consumption-based pricing. Eligible for co-sell discounts and Azure GSI uplift where applicable. Contact Nebula for integration plans and Redwood for dedicated sizing."

Also attaching a short tech note on metering compatibility across GCP/Azure (we flagged places that typically require a shim). Laura — I'll send the final tag after you confirm portal timeline.

-V
Vivek Kulkarni
Partner GTM Lead | Redwood Inference
